info.title: Hamnivo API
info.description: Public API for Hamnivo. Every request is authorized against the caller's tenant, scope and resource; identifiers are never authorization by themselves. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.

post.summary: Start or resume a widget session for this browser
Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
Exchange a tenant-signed identity assertion for a verified customer session
End this session and remove the identity from this browser (logout)

get.summary: List the signed-in customer's own conversations

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key bound to the request body hash; reuse with a different body returns 409

get.summary: Page through customer-visible messages, newest first

post.summary: Send a message; retries with the same clientMessageId are deduplicated

202.description: Accepted after the conversation authority committed it

post.summary: Report that messages up to a sequence were displayed to the customer
Ask for a person. Always honoured; availability is reported honestly
Reopen a resolved conversation, keeping its history
Upload a file into quarantine; it becomes available only after scanning
